metadata.description: Small Claude Code plugins that change the terminal interface: usage, screenshots, PR links, a session plan, and a session picker.

plugins.name: usage-footer
plugins.description: Shows weekly and 5-hour plan usage on the right of the prompt footer row

plugins.name: screenshot-pane
plugins.description: Shows screenshots and other images from tool calls in a side pane (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty)

plugins.name: pr-link
plugins.description: Shows a clickable link above the prompt for each PR that gh pr create opens in this session, with a status circle for each PR

plugins.name: session-plan
plugins.description: Keeps a high-level plan of the session (goal, done, now, next) in a toggleable side pane and the status line

plugins.name: session-picker
plugins.description: A pane of recent sessions in this directory, each one a button that resumes it
